phrase.zh: 把复杂形状，放进更简洁的坐标。
phrase.en: Place complexity in a simpler set of coordinates.

visual.zh: 柔软曲面和散落点位在画中渐渐收拢，表现数据表示的变化。这不是训练后模型的真实潜在空间投影。
visual.en: Soft surfaces and scattered points draw together, suggesting a change in data representation. This is not an actual projection from a trained model.

background.zh: 潜在变量模型用看不见的变量表示观测数据中的结构。变分自编码器在 2013 年提出一种可学习这类表示的方法；画中接近的点不保证代表语义相近的真实事物。
background.en: Latent-variable models use hidden variables to represent structure in observed data. Variational auto-encoders, introduced in 2013, offer a way to learn such representations; nearby drawn points do not imply measured semantic similarity.
